entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I need to start a return for some cycling shoes I bought a couple of months ago.
I can certainly help with that. Do you have the order number handy?

Great, thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Lace cycling shoes, delivered on October 3rd. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's a fit issue, really. I've tried everything, even adjusting the cleats multiple times, but I keep getting terrible blisters on my heels after any ride longer than an hour. They just aren't working for my foot shape.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is the last thing you want on a ride. Let me check the return eligibility for you. I see they were delivered 61 days ago. One moment...
Alright, I've confirmed it. Because it's a standard item, it falls within our 90-day return policy. We can definitely process a full refund for you.
Oh, that's a relief. Thank you. I was worried it might have been too long. I'll get the refund once you receive them back?
That's correct. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now. Just box them up, attach the label, and drop them off. Once our warehouse scans it in, the refund will be processed.

Excellent. I appreciate you making that easy. Since I plan on ordering a different pair of cycling shoes from your site, and considering the trouble with the blisters, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next purchase?

That's a reasonable request. I can see you're a long-time VIP customer with us, and we definitely want to make sure you get into a pair of shoes that work for you. As a gesture of goodwill, I can add a 20% discount voucher directly to your account. You'll be able to apply it at checkout on your next order.
Wow, 20% is fantastic. That's more than I expected. Thank you, Charlie. You've been extremely helpful today.
You're very welcome. The return label is on its way, and the discount is now active on your account. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
